Opening your story studio…

A working prototype

Your experience, in your words.

This demo walks through an athlete interview, source-backed moments, review, photo tagging, and a visual story.

  • The interview is simulated. It uses authored questions and answer-dependent branches. No live AI service is connected.
  • Your work stays in this browser. IndexedDB stores your story and images on this device. There is no account, cloud backup, or public story link. Export a copy to keep your work.
  • Sample stories and training records are synthetic. Your own answers remain separate from the examples.
  • Photos stay local. Uploads are not sent to a model or an external media service.

Supabase persistence, live model interviewing, connected activity services, and optional generated imagery are planned integrations.
